sources.name: xAI X Search
sources.role: Real-time X keyword, semantic, user, and thread search with citations.
sources.notes: Requires XAI_API_KEY. Social volume and sentiment never raise factual confidence on their own.

sources.name: xAI Web Search
sources.role: Wide web discovery and corroboration with source URLs.
sources.notes: Runs with X Search so official reporting and social reporting can be compared.

sources.name: The Week in Fantasy — Overall
sources.role: External comparison surface for overall player movement.
sources.notes: The site disallows automated access to /leaderboard/. Use only through a licensed API/export or manual comparison.

sources.name: The Week in Fantasy — ADP Risers
sources.role: External comparison surface for seven-day ADP movement.

sources.name: The Week in Fantasy — Positive Sentiment
sources.role: External comparison surface for positive fantasy sentiment.

sources.name: The Week in Fantasy — Positive Sentiment Risers
sources.role: External comparison surface for changes in positive sentiment.

sources.name: The Week in Fantasy — Performance Classification
sources.role: External comparison surface for performance-classified discussion.

sources.name: Fantasy-Football-AI-CoManager
sources.role: Reference for provider abstraction, MCP surfaces, and graceful handling of missing news credentials.
sources.notes: No code copied because reusable rights are not granted by a repository license.

sources.name: nfl_mcp
sources.role: Reference for health checks, provider separation, caching, injury corroboration, and evaluation surfaces.
sources.notes: Bowser keeps its own contracts and does not embed this server.

sources.name: fantasy-football-ai
sources.role: Reference for feature provenance, model versioning, evaluation, and FastAPI-style service boundaries.
sources.notes: Forecasting logic is outside this news-intelligence slice.

sources.name: pick-ems
sources.role: Reference for narrow analyst prompts that preserve teams, injuries, trades, and league classification.

sources.name: FantasyChatbot (HIKE)
sources.role: Reference for RAG-backed injury/news context and time-series-aware fantasy analysis.
sources.notes: The football dataset and model stack are dated; no code copied.

sources.name: GoalMine
sources.role: Reference for parallel source roles, deterministic scoring around LLM output, run health, and graceful degradation.
sources.notes: Soccer betting code and prompts are not reused.

sources.name: ai-news-summarizer-sentiment-analysis
sources.license: README claims MIT; no repository license file verified
sources.role: Reference for a fetch → summarize → sentiment service boundary.
sources.notes: Generic sentiment is not used as fantasy sentiment and no code is copied.

sources.name: fantasy-football-twitter-analysis
sources.role: Historical reference for analyst-account filtering and social-sentiment aggregation.
sources.notes: The Twitter API and VADER implementation is dated; Bowser separates social buzz from reporting confidence.
